ROOT CAUSE (live recon 2026-10-20): watchhentai is Dooplay-theme — series pages render the full episode list inside <ul class="episodios"> with SINGLE-quoted href='...'; epsWHFromHtml only matched double-quoted href="..." so it caught 1 stray link (the page's own /videos/ URL) → eps.length===1 → auto-jump to quality. Every "single-episode" jump was fake. FIXES: (1) epsWHFromHtml rewritten — quote-agnostic hrefs, scoped to ul.episodios blocks when present (video watch pages carry 29 stray /videos/ links incl. related titles → scoped parse = only the real sibling episode list, zero pollution), /feed/ RSS links excluded, season-N slugs → "S2 EP1" labels, stable (season,ep) sort. (2) hvGo series stage: eps>1 → REAL episode menu (session stage ep) → episode quote → quality menu → download; eps===1 → straight to quality (kept); eps===0 → no more 'episodes නෑ' throw — gracefully treats the pick as a standalone video and goes straight to quality. (3) hvEpsCard: episode count + EP_CAP truncation note. LIVE VERIFIED: kazoku series page 6 eps / video page 6 eps no pollution / ikkyuu-nyuukon 4 eps (old parser: 1/1/1).
